script_text: Stop treating this week like noise, Aries, because your fire-sign ruler Mars is igniting a financial reset. From Monday to Wednesday, the Sun in your 8th House squares Jupiter in your 5th, exposing one desire that costs more than it should. Venus retrograde in your 7th House opposes Saturn in your 1st, so love asks for honesty, not ego. The First Quarter Moon in your 11th House squares the Sun, forcing a choice between a public opportunity and a private need. Late week, Mercury in your 9th House clears legal or long-distance confusion. Jupiter trines Saturn, turning a disciplined creative project into paid recognition. Wednesday is your power day because the Moon in Aquarius activates your 11th House and delivers an ally. Friday is your worst day because Sun square Jupiter can overspend or overpromise. Negotiate every number before Thursday ends. Follow for daily updates.
